headline: Names a Cupertino, California Post Office building after Navy SEAL Matthew G. Axelson.
what_it_does: This law officially designates a United States Postal Service facility at 21701 Stevens Creek Boulevard in Cupertino, California, as the Petty Officer 2nd Class (SEAL) Matthew G. Axelson Post Office Building. It changes the building's official name but does not change how the Post Office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2020.
